messages:
rachel: FYI our example that targets Vercel Edge is throwing "Cannot use import statement outside a module" in preview. Works locally.

omar: That screams CJS/ESM resolution. Do we have conditional exports?

rachel: Nope, package.json only has main/module/types.

priya: Add an exports map with an "edge" condition so edge runtimes get the pure ESM bundle. e.g. 
```json
"exports": {
  "edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
  "import": "./dist/node-esm/index.mjs",
  "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs"
}
```
This fixed a customer's Vercel deploy earlier.

omar: Also saw a support ticket where clients started getting TS2769 after we swapped some public params from any -> unknown. Overloads started failing.

priya: Overloads + unknown breaks inference on older TS. Two pragmatic fixes: 1) simplify overloads into a single generic entry to aid inference; 2) ship a compatibility d.ts for older compilers and use typesVersions to route them.

rachel: Example consolidation suggestion: 
```ts
// instead of two overloads
function init(opts: InitOptions): Client;
function init(token: string): Client;
// do one generic
function init<T extends InitOptions | string>(arg: T): Client;
```
This reduces TS' overload resolution surprises.

omar: For typesVersions mapping we can do: 
```json
"typesVersions": {
  "<4.8": { "*": ["dist/types-compat/*"] },
  "*": { "*": ["dist/types/*"] }
}
```
where types-compat uses looser any types.

priya: Another subtle runtime issue: AbortController/signal semantics differ at Edge, causing our retry loop to not cancel properly. Guard against missing globals: 
```ts
const makeController = () => typeof AbortController !== 'undefined' ? new AbortController() : polyfillAbortController();
```
and make the retry backoff bail when signal isn't supported.

rachel: I'll implement exports + a tiny example wrapper that picks edge vs node bundle based on runtime detect (helps onboarding). Also will add a Vercel preview smoke test to CI.

docs-bot: Created issue #1543: sdk-edge-packaging-typing-compat assigned to @rachel and @priya.

omar: I'll draft a short contributor note for the SDK repo explaining the packaging patterns (exports, typesVersions, tsconfig tips) so folks stop reintroducing the same breakage.

priya: Quick tsconfig tip for examples that helped: set module=ESNext, moduleResolution=NodeNext and skipLibCheck=true. Put it in examples/tsconfig.edge.json.

rachel: Thanks team, will ship a canary and test. :rocket:
